about: Prompt-level cases from a person's verdicts and notes on 122 pictures (evals/story-pictures.json: human, human_note; evals/paired-verdicts.json: per version human, human_note, way). A failing case is a fault the person noted (or, for a picture judged partly or wrong without a note, the fault the blind judge or the picture judge named: fault_from), with expectations on the moment's preparation (its rebuilt prompt and references) that, met, would have prevented it. A passing case is a moment the person called right, with what must stay true of it. code expectations name a check in evals/prompt-cases.ts (CHECKS); ask expectations are yes-or-no questions Jev answers about the prompt text. model_only: nothing in the preparation could have prevented the fault (it already does its part); set_aside: the note disagrees with the dream as the dreamer told it. Both are run and shown, and kept out of the pass rates. Ids in args are the saved dream's own (p1 is the dreamer in every one of these dreams). unused: notes that gave no case, and why.
